latest_release.name: 0.47.0: d1 Omni decision model
latest_release.body:
This release updates the engine to b12110, which adds support for d1 Omni, Liquid AI's tiny decision model. Give it text, images, audio or video and typed questions, and it returns a probability for each option.

- Update the engine to b12110, adding support for d1 Omni
- Show when a model fails to load, and say when the engine may be too old
- Use the app's own engine when your llama.cpp install is too old
- Suggest a good first model at the top of Recommended for your Mac
